name: HTML-serial
tagline: A one-page Web Serial console: open a COM port in Chrome or Edge, set baud, bits, parity and flow control, and watch what arrives.
about: SerialTest.html, a single self-contained page that connects to a serial port through the browser's Web Serial API and prints what comes in. There is no README beyond the title and no published site. Flood-Net's Serial Monitor tab does the same job with the same port settings and much more (several ports, hex and ALERT decode, Quansheng, ERT-A2 and RTL-SDR cards, posting to Flood-Net), so it has replaced this in practice, though nothing in Flood-Net cites it.

status.summary: A dormant prototype, replaced by Flood-Net's Serial Monitor tab; not marked archived on GitHub, last touched 13 Oct 2026 for a CLAUDE.md note.

components.name: Port settings and connect
components.what: Baud rate, data bits, stop bits, parity and flow control, then the browser's port chooser.

components.name: Terminal output
components.what: Prints the incoming stream as text, with a clear button and a connection status.
